valor: Separada de su madre al cruzar la selva entre Colombia y Panamá, Zuli, una pequeña migrante venezolana, se ve obligada a dejar su infancia para sobrevivir y trabaja para un coyote que guía migrantes. En uno de sus viajes tropieza con un portal a una tierra mágica donde reconecta con su inocencia y su imaginación y aprende a ser niña otra vez.

valor: Separated from her mother while crossing the jungle between Colombia and Panama, Zuli, a young Venezuelan migrant, must abandon her childhood to survive and works for a coyote who guides migrants. On one trip she stumbles upon a portal to a magical land where she reconnects with her innocence and imagination and learns to be a child again.

antes.ficdeh-2026: After being separated from her mother while crossing the treacherous jungle between Colombia and Panama, Zuli, a young Venezuelan migrant, is forced to abandon her childhood to survive in this dangerous place. While working for a coyote to help guide other migrants through the jungle, Zuli discovers a portal to a magical land, where she must turn to her imagination to reconnect with her innocence and, ultimately, learn how to be a kid again.
